competitors.name: Kroger
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported Kroger named former Walmart e-commerce executive and Jet.com co-founder Nate Faust as executive vice president and chief e-commerce officer, effective Sept. 1. Kroger is adding the role after online sales grew 19% year over year in its most recent quarter and e-commerce turned profitable for the first time.

competitors.name: Wegmans
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported Wegmans launched Wegmans for Athletics, a food, nutrition and hydration program for collegiate, youth and professional sports organizations. The program uses Meals 2Go catering, large-order fulfillment, Wegmans brand snacks, hydration and supplements, and nutrition education to extend the grocer's prepared-food and wellness services beyond conventional catering.

competitors.name: U.S. grocery retail
competitors.action: Supermarket News launched its monthly Grocery Gauge and scored the industry at 48 for July, citing soft earnings, moderate inflation pressure and mixed store opening/closing data despite stronger store traffic. The gauge noted Albertsons lowered its full-year outlook and projected identical sales could decline as much as 1.5%, while Ahold Delhaize USA warned SNAP cuts will pressure results.

trends.topic: Large grocers prioritizing digital execution and retail media economics
trends.magnitude: Kroger reported 19% online sales growth and first-time e-commerce profitability in its most recent quarter
trends.context: Retailer conversations are likely to put more weight on digital readiness, delivery economics and store-based fulfillment. Real Dough should keep product data, retailer content and online assortment assets accurate for major accounts.

trends.topic: Grocers extending prepared food into targeted nutrition services
trends.magnitude: Wegmans is packaging Meals 2Go, large-order fulfillment, branded snacks, hydration and nutrition education into an athletics program
trends.context: Prepared-food and wellness programs are becoming account-specific service platforms, not just in-store departments. Real Dough can watch for partnership and catering-adjacent openings where premium pizza fits team meals, events or community programs.

trends.topic: Retailer operating pressure remains high despite traffic gains
trends.magnitude: Supermarket News' July Grocery Gauge scored the industry at 48; Placer.ai data showed grocery visits up across formats while earnings stayed soft
trends.context: Buyers may stay cautious on new branded assortment unless products show clear velocity, margin support and differentiation. Premium frozen brands should assume tighter scrutiny on price points and promotional support.
